title: An export table
description:
Model a DLL's export table and look functions up by name and by ordinal.

```
exports of mathlib.dll (base 0x180000000):
  @1 add       RVA 0x1010 -> 0x180001010
  @2 multiply  RVA 0x1040 -> 0x180001040
lookup "add": 0x180001010
lookup @2: multiply
lookup "divide": not exported
```
hints: An RVA is an offset from wherever the module is loaded, which is why the same table works at any base (lesson 1.02).
The real table keeps names sorted so the loader can binary-search them; sort yours and use `std::lower_bound` for a bonus.
requirements: `struct Export { std::string name; std::uint16_t ordinal; std::uint32_t rva; };`
Find by name (exact, case-sensitive, as `GetProcAddress` does) and by ordinal.
The address is the module base plus the RVA.
stretch: Add forwarded exports (`"other.dll!Func"`) that point to another module.
